notes.title: Development Pause
notes.content:
Hello guys,

As the title reads, the development on Courier 79 has been halted. I've already made a decent progress on the next area but it got me burned out really fast. So much so that I will be taking a break from it for a little while. Forcing myself to work on this would just not be good on the final product. 

The game is nearing 1000 wishlists which is insane for me so I want this game to be good. I want this game to be enjoyable. 

I am sorry for the delay, here is atleast a screenshot of the new area.

notes.title: Town Center Closure, Perks, New Benefits and more
notes.content:
It's over, I'm like 90% finished with this part of the game and will be creating a whole new area now *(finally..)*. This process might take a while but I want to perfect this so I'm taking my time here. Anyways, I'm feeling quite good about the state of courier right now, lets hope it stays this way. 
Enough talk, patch notes time!

[h3][b]Introducing PERKS!![/b][/h3]
By playing the game and completing various challenges, you gain permanent perks. You can select one perk for a run when the game starts. Right now there are 5 perks that you can unlock. All perks should be useful and should give you a good head start for synergies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581248/e621e687e733b43934b85a8065a885091e2633fa.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Added a Map[/b][/h3]
You now have access to the map. At first, the map will be blank and you will need to piece the map together to get the most of it. You can toggle the map with M (Start for controllers) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581248/3abdda5b429ea397dbc1bbaa8af00d55f23ea7c0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Call-Ins[/b][/h3]
You can now call for orders with TAB (Right Bumper). This interaction skips the waiting time completely and generates a new order immediately with a little less time for delivery. Each Call-In order grants a small tip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581248/cf305e8580be93959cf1357d858786bcad750cc7.gif[/img]

[h3]Benefits and upgrades:[/h3]
[i][b]Removed:[/b][/i]
[i]Careful Skids, Ultimate Road Kit, Anti-Sneeze Syrup, Sneeze Syrup[/i]

[i][b]Retouched:[/b][/i]
[b]Junk Compass[/b] reworked. Now points towards the shop instead of nearest destination.
[b]Risk Taker[/b] reworked. Special orders spawn more frequently [u]and upon delivery, every order regenerates 7 seconds[/u]
[b]One Moment Please[/b] - Start On-Hold state: [strike]5s[/strike] >> 8s
[b]Bible[/b] now restores 15 seconds on each order if triggered successfully
[b]Risk Taker[/b] now restores 7s for every package after delivering a special order.
[b]Great Deal![/b] gain 1 strike instead of 2 but start your next day with slashed tires.
[b]FQchange.rlb[/b] - Cops will strike you when you speed past them with this item.
[b]Adrenaline Rush[/b] renamed to [b]Rushdrenaline[/b]
and various price adjustments in the shop

[i][b]New:[/b][/i]
Added 8 new benefits and 4 new items.

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
All active items are now cooldown dependent. I think its way better to have a cooldown approach instead of single use.
Wheel of fortune money reward: [strike]250€[/strike] >> 170€
Mechanic skill tree is now way more expensive, requiring +- 1000€ to unlock a single section
Locals during Rush Hour Event Day are faster
Veterran NPC has been brought back (same quest as before but now gives a reward)
When handling quests given by NPCs, all orders get paused (deleted and reset previously)

[h3]QoL and fixes:[/h3]
Ironed out some issues with drones
Fog visuals have been updated
Improved collisions
Bible now has a new animation whenever it triggers (actually insane)
*Hopefully* fixed pick up triggers. They should not get voided now
Delivered packages (props thrown when you deliver package) dont deal damage to the player
Adjusted vehicle acceleration when offroad
Reliablo now displays ticket count
Special order spawning has been fixed and now spawn as intended
Fixed some AI issues
Orders now have hp bar
Fixed some benefits not behaving correctly

thanks for sticking around ːsteamhappyː ːcleandinoː

notes.title: Courier 79 v0.3d - MAJOR GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Courier 79 v0.3d - MAJOR GAMEPLAY UPDATE[/h2]

New patchnotes!!!!!!

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

- [b]Pharuuk's Daily Shop is back![/b] Instead of the classic static shop, I've decided to go with a mobile approach which should feel a lot better. The shop also has 2 types
    ↳ 1st type: a normal shop with 3 items
    ↳ 2nd type: a shop where you can gamble tickets for items, or even gain a strike..

- [b]Reliablo now has a battery.[/b] The battery depletes slowly and upon reaching 0%, reliablo will go offline. You can charge your reliablo anytime by stopping at charging stations

- [b]Added 2 new order types[/b]
    ↳ [i]Urgent:[/i] a rare order type that spawns with a short amount of time on clock, but gives ton of money
    ↳ [i]Contraband:[/i] an order type that requires you to be extra careful when roaming the city. Radars will recognize this order and will grant you a strike immediately

- [b]Added Event Days.[/b] Event days occur every third day.
    ↳  Event Day: Pollution - Oil Spillages that will fasten your vehicle and nails that will puncture your tires and offset your turning will spawn around the map
    ↳ Event Day: Rush Hour - Order spawn rates are decreased

- [b]Added Pharuuk Tickets.[/b] Tickets are a new rare currency which you get +1 every day. Currently only usable for gambling

- Added Water Puddles that will slow your vehicle down and make it slippery (only during rain)
- Added Roadblocks
- Added Sneezing, the player will sneeze every once in a while, impairing vision and offsetting the vehicle slightly
- Added locals that will roam around the city in cars
- Removed reputation. Reputation in its current state was confusing and pretty much pointless gameplaywise
- Temporary disabled job switching and Post Office job
- Temporary disabled Veterran and Sara
- Repair costs have been adjusted and are now paired to a vehicle
- Added Pharuuks Wheel of Fortune. The wheel has 6 sides; 3 of them will reward you, the other 3 will punish you
- Added Cocaine (not usable, [i]yet?[/i]). Cocaine is the first contraband order. You can get your hands on cocaine by talking to Rick on 4th day. There is a little twist and only experienced players who know the map very well can pull this off
- Premium packages are now based on hits rather than linear damage. By default, 4 hits to destroy a premium order
- Cuts for damages are back; whenever you drastically damage an order, 35% will be cut from your paycheck
- Speed Radar fine has been reduced: [strike]50€[/strike] > 30€
- Hamburger, fries and pizza's weights have been increased

Updated pricing of special orders:
    ↳ Premium: (order cost * 1.5) €
    ↳ Urgent: (order cost * 1.3) €
    ↳ Contraband: (order cost * 2) €

- All trunk spaces have been lowered as follows:
[b]> Saetta - [strike]12[/strike] >> 10
> Grande Spillo - [strike]8[/strike] >> 7
> Masso v1 - [strike]40[/strike] >> 30[/b]

[b]Other:[/b]
- Redesigned Benefit menu
- Mechanic now displays a skill tree with various gameplay changing perks
- Reliablo has received a design overhaul once again. It now features battery, current active item and strikes
- Added a progress bar which shows you how far you are from the game's end
- Some signs have been adjusted
- Redesigned interaction boxes (pickup, deliver)

[b]QoL and fixes:[/b]
- You can now open Reliablo with Up Arrow)
- Orders should no longer get voided. This happened whenever you got a strike and the game did not delete the destination, rendering deliveries impossible
- Added an indicator that shows pretty much every action
- Added Full Controller Support! You should be now able to complete the game from start to finish only using a controller
- Reworked and shortened the tutorial
- Added Controls menu in the settings
- Graphic settings and gameplay settings now save and display proper option
- Order damages are now finally fixed, you wont be able to damage an order that is not in your inventory

Okay.. that was a long one, what now? Tomorrow starts a 'Planes, Trains, and Automobiles Fest' steam fest that i will be a part of so thats exciting. I will do one small update after that ends that should cover bugfixes, some visual changes that bother me and some small stuff and that will conclude the first chapter of Courier 79. Next up will be a brand new area which im very excited about. But on that later :)

thanks for sticking around

notes.title: Courier 79 v0.2d - QoL Update
notes.content:
Hello, second to last demo update is here, containing a lot of changes regarding quality of life. Next and (probably) final demo update will focus solely on gameplay, feel, replayability and fun stuff, so stay tuned!

Full changelog is here:

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Grande Spillo's friction values have been adjusted a bit. Should feel less slippery.
[*] Masso v1 pretty much lost it's purpose after the last update so I've increased the armor drastically.
[*] First 3 orders of the day will generate in a quick succession so you can get into the gameplay sooner
[*] Order delivery times have been slightly adjusted due to the change above
[*] Bushes dont act like a stone wall now, instead they slow you down
[*] Removed wind mechanic (i broke something and couldnt fix it, probably for the best)
[/list]

Story:
[list]
[*] Added a new quest with underground beatmaker Veterran
[*] Added a new quest with Veterran's druggie friend, Rick
[*] Added ending to handler's storyline
[/list]

QoL: 
[list]
[*] Dialogue is now more dynamic. Whenever you are staying still, you may take as long as you want to read the dialogue, but while driving, the dialogue will advance automatically.
[*] Added Master Volume setting
[*] Dialogue can be progressed with Space and Enter now
[*] Redesigned signs and improved collisions on them
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Added a Junkyard
[*] Added anti aliasing
[*] Redesigned Masso v1
[*] Reliablo design has been reworked; now displays strikes as well as current active item (if you have one)
[*] Added crows 
[*] Redesigned interaction UI (when close to npcs)
[*] Post office orders now shouldnt cause any memory leaks
[*] Fixed a bug where vehicles moved on its own while in cutscenes and at the start of new day
[*] Fixed some softlock interactions
[/list]
